Metric: Percentage of cases executed in less than a given time

Metric: Percentage of cases with an activity
Rework rate (any activity more than once)
SiGNAL expression: COUNT(case_id) FILTER (WHERE (SELECT COUNT(event_name) > COUNT(DISTINCT event_name)))  100.0 / COUNT(case_id)

Metric: Repetitions of one activity (average per case)
Cases ending with the expected activity
